description: Copies one signal into a set number of polyphonic channels, with an optional voltage spread between those channels

params.text: Sets how many channels the output carries, 1 to 16, when nothing is patched to the Channels input
Attenuates the voltage at the Spread input, which counts as 2V when nothing is patched there
Uni builds the spread upwards from the input voltage, and Bi centres the spread on the input voltage

inputs.text: The signal copied to every output channel; the channels of a polyphonic cable are summed to one voltage first
A monophonic cable here sets the channel count at two channels per volt, and a polyphonic one sets it to its own number of channels
Sets how far apart the channel voltages are placed, attenuated by the Spread knob

outputs.text: The copied signal, one channel per clone, spread apart by the spread setting

menu: Legacy — applies the spread setting between each neighbouring pair of channels; unticked, the setting is the whole difference between the lowest and highest channel
Clipping — clamps every output channel to -10V and 10V; unticked, the channels run past that
